server.description: An MCP server configured for an org.

id.description: The server's identifier, unique within the org.

authType.description: How pear authenticates to the server. oauth: each member signs in with their own account via MCP OAuth (brokered by Nango). manual: an admin configured the server's URL and any headers once for the whole org, and every member is connected automatically.

header.description: A static HTTP header sent on every request to a manually configured MCP server, e.g. an API key.
